debrief db-021
1) the actor m-o-n-i-t-o-r-e-d the c-l-i-e-n-t a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s and left a l-o-g f-i-l-e o-f i-p a-d-d-r-e-s-s-e-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-c-c-e-s-s l-i-m-i-t v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n
2) the actor e-x-p-l-o-i-t-e-d the a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-a-t-i-o-n f-l-o-w to g-a-i-n a-d-m-i-n r-i-g-h-t-s and left a s-t-e-a-l-t-h c-o-o-k-i-e t-r-a-c-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the s-e-s-s-i-o-n r-e-v-i-e-w
3) the actor d-r-a-i-n-e-d the g-i-f-t c-a-r-d b-a-l-a-n-c-e-s into c-a-s-h o-u-t-l-e-t s and left a t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n r-e-c-e-i-p-t p-a-t-t-e-r-n while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the t-h-r-e-s-h-o-l-d a-l-e-r-t
4) the actor f-a-k-e-d the p-u-r-c-h-a-s-e p-a-t-t-e-r-n-s to b-e normal and left a d-a-t-a-s-e-t o-f m-o-c-k i-t-e-m s-k-u-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-n-o-m-a-l-y d-e-t-e-c-t
5) the actor c-l-o-s-e-d the t-r-a-i-l-b-a-c-k by r-o-t-a-t-i-n-g the p-a-s-s-w-o-r-d-s and left a c-l-e-a-n-s-l-i-p r-e-p-o-r-t while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-o-r-e-n-s-i-c p-r-e-s-e-r-v-a-t-i-o-n
